videos.title: Roblox News Today: RIVALS Black Friday Sale, Overflow Scythe Rework & 7 New Codes 🚨 #roblox
videos.description:
Today's Roblox news: RIVALS is running its first Black Friday sale with up to 40% off 7 bundles (ends Dec 1, 12 AM ET) after Season 4 Part 2 added the Holodome and Shield Surge, Overflow's Nov 26 update reworked the Scythe and added a free Tidecaller Rod, and Roblox Web Play (still a creator beta) now renders with WebGPU for sharper avatars, grass and lighting. Plus 3 games have 7 new codes.

Chapters:

0:30 Overflow Scythe Rework + Tidecaller Rod
0:46 Roblox Web Play Switches to WebGPU
1:01 Overflow, Beyond Nen + Stand Out Codes
1:26 Coming Up + Outro

Codes in this video:
Overflow: FORGOTSCYTHESORRY (30 Style Rolls + 25 Passive Rolls), UPDATEYAY (25 Style Rolls + 25 Passive Rolls), ILOVEFISHINGLOL (15 Style Rolls + 15 Passive Rolls + 30 min 2x Mastery EXP)
Beyond Nen: DECAYSICK (35 Spins), DECAYGIFT (Clear Negative Nen Orb + Reset Orb + 10 Spins)
Stand Out: THANKFULFORSTANDOUT, REAL200KLIKES (free Arrows + Dalas; amounts vary by source; join the Studio Umbra: Europa group)

Codes may expire at any time, so redeem them fast! Event times are in Eastern Time and can change.
